scope: Completed local college-project implementation and portable container verification. Cloud hosting was explicitly left aside; optional provider configuration was not provisioned and incurred no hosting spend.

readyRequires: nonempty valid ASCII workspace token in public mode
real temporary file write/fsync/rename/read with cleanup
actual bounded 128-sample production CNN forward pass
checks.cacheInvalidatesFor: Token, path, worker, replica, port or launch-argument configuration changes
checks.startupPreflight: Always fresh; closes SQLite handles before replacing its process with explicit one-worker Uvicorn
readinessDoesNotProve: Physical persistence of a writable mount; provider disk configuration and restart verification are still required
Discovery of undeclared extra replicas on unrelated disks
Independent RF accuracy or model calibration
checks.privateProbeRecovery: Exact owned temporary filename pattern plus complete/partial known marker; unrelated files and committed recordings are preserved.

providerConfiguration.runtimeUser: Only /data mount ownership may be initialized as root. Non-symlink workspace children are created after supplementary-group/GID/UID drop. API UID10001; existing record files are never recursively chowned.
providerConfiguration.existingFileOwnership: Never rewritten recursively; a restored workspace needs explicit correct ownership.
providerConfiguration.status: Unused optional manual configuration; college-project delivery requires no cloud account.

optional.availability: Independent current Linux TensorFlow CPU2.21 verification profile passed original CNN/neural vector replay and full installed-package audit after pip26.3 remediation. It is not required for the college application.

allFourMemoryObservation.scope: Four genuine three-frame API evaluations and matched comparison; all360 independent reference vectors per neural model passed in the same512MiB Linux container. This is an executed workload observation, not a universal capacity guarantee.
